constraints.description: The ordinary root excludes inspector code and DOM effects; only the explicit debug entries expose or mount it.

validation.validation_method: Run the packed Vite/Next gate and inspect package exports, sideEffects, and production chunks.

constraints.description: Graph Pulse, entity values/history, view membership, preview/restore, and time travel reflect controller-owned production state without inferred rendered visibility.

validation.validation_method: Run the complete packed browser workflow and compare UI copy against controller projections and the ui-spec.

constraints.description: Remote/serialized values remain metadata-only unless explicitly included and redacted; the UI cannot grant commit authority.

validation.validation_method: Inspect source/docs and require packed policy workflows to pass without exposing sentinel values.

constraints.description: The inspector preserves accessible semantic interaction, responsive layout, visible focus, virtualization, deferred search, bounded rendering cadence, and reduced motion.

validation.validation_method: Require packed Chromium keyboard/screen-reader/responsive/load lanes plus retained screenshots and metrics.

constraints.description: Built exports, skills, README files, Docusaurus guidance, generated API reference, screenshots, and receipts match the implemented three-entry surface.

validation.validation_method: Refresh/verify the React export ledger, run API generation, and inspect every public record.

constraints.description: At least 12 developers across first-time and oriented cohorts perform the seeded dirty-entity and registered-view tasks; 10 of 12 succeed unassisted and each cohort median is under 10 seconds.

validation.validation_method: Inspect the retained participant protocol/results and timing evidence; automated browser runs do not satisfy this constraint.

global_rules: Refinement may correct observed implementation, design, documentation, or evidence defects but may not broaden into Chrome or Flutter extension work.
Only the complete packed Vite/Next/Chromium suite counts as automated behavioral evidence.
Do not create or run unit, component, isolated, mock-backed, snapshot, or partial tests.
Do not claim formatively certified world-class UX or archive readiness without the human usability record.
Impeccable absence must be disclosed; available Anthropic and Vercel reviews do not impersonate it.
termination_conditions: All six blocking constraints are satisfied.
The API generator, entry ledger, packed browser receipt, artifact validation, isolated adversarial review, and sycophancy correction pass.
No further delta improves truthfulness, usability, security clarity, visual quality, or traceability.
